# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }}

{{ site.author.name }} is a {{ site.author.role }} at {{ site.author.org }},
based in {{ site.author.location }}. This site is his personal homepage: a
professional profile plus a small collection of writing. It is a static
Jekyll site with no tracking, and all content is free to read and quote
with attribution.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): biography, education, full work history and publications.
- [Writing]({{ '/writing/' | absolute_url }}): index of all posts, filterable by tag and searchable.
